operations.path: src/ledger/20260820-1236 The Five-Site Multi-Wall Landau Search Has a Finite Source Census.md
operations.body: The frozen 180-term packet admits 245 compatible labelled wall pairs in 49 free C5 orbits and 1210 triples in 242 free C5 orbits. Coarse source-derived partitions give 29 pair and 93 triple profiles. The packet retains exact representatives and term multiplicities; no Landau-solution claim is made.

operations.body: Entry 1236 closes the admissible multi-wall search domain: 49 exact pair-orbit representatives and 242 triple-orbit representatives, with 29/93 coarse cut-incidence profiles. No fixed C5 subsets. I will solve pairs first using a generic cut-incidence Landau system; exact labelled representatives remain the certification layer, and any profile split must come from routing invariants.
